summary: Full e2e test of the 4 new storefront features on Chez Dina Boutique. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (after one minor assertion correction — see RCA note). Frontend: all critical flows pass: multi-image carousel + thumbnails + prev/next + dot indicator, per-size/pointure stock labels (rupture / X restants / dispo), out-of-stock sizes correctly disabled, 'X en stock pour la pointure {size}' line, add-to-cart with toast, reviews modal (5-star picker + name + comment + Publier) creates review via POST /api/public/reviews and review appears instantly, catalog cards show ★ rating next to price, checkout cart items with per-item carousel chevrons + mini dots, GPS 'Utiliser ma position actuelle' triggers geolocation and renders OpenStreetMap iframe (correct bbox) with 'Repositionner' + 'Voir sur Maps' + visible lat/lng, order submission with Wave payment creates order and redirects to /suivi/{code} with correct item + total; backend persists customer.lat and customer.lng as verified via /api/orders/track/{code}.

minor.issue: Posting a review recomputes rating_avg/rating_count purely from the reviews collection, which overwrites the (synthetic) seeded aggregate. A seeded product with rating_count=12 drops to rating_count=1 after the first real review is posted. Not a bug per se, but a seed/UX inconsistency: seeded rating_count values do not reflect real reviews.

issues: The cart line item column is very narrow: size/color/price text (e.g., '38 · Marine') wraps vertically into a column of single letters next to the thumbnail. Readable but visually cramped.
/api/auth/me returns 401 (expected for anon users) and the frontend calls it on every public page, producing noisy console errors. Consider skipping the call when no access_token cookie is present.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress /auth/me call on public /boutique/* and /suivi/* routes to clean up console 401 noise.

(Optional) When computing rating aggregate after a new review, blend with the seeded synthetic values OR drop synthetic rating_count on seed so there is no visible 'drop' when the first real review arrives.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines and getting dense; consider splitting (auth, catalog/public, orders, seed, ai) into separate modules.
/public/orders accepts arbitrary customer dict with no validation — fine for lat/lng flexibility but should at least validate phone/name non-empty server-side.
Seed assigns random rating_avg/rating_count to products that have 0 reviews, which breaks consistency when real reviews are posted (see minor backend issue).
test_credentials: No auth required for storefront flows (public endpoints).
seed_data_creation: Created test review (TEST_review excellent / TEST_Cliente) and a test order (TEST_Buyer, GPS 5.36/-4.00, Wave) via backend tests and UI flow. These are prefixed with TEST_ in customer_name for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features (multi-image carousel, per-size stock labels + disabled OOS sizes, 5-star reviews with aggregate update, GPS pin on checkout with OSM iframe + lat/lng in order) are shipped and working end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend endpoints: GET /api/public/reviews/{pid}, POST /api/public/reviews, GET /api/public/product/{pid} with images[] + stock_by_size + rating_avg/count, POST /api/public/orders accepts customer.lat/lng. Data-testids used (all present): product-main-image, product-prev, product-next, product-thumb-{i}, product-size-{s}, product-add-cart, product-review-open, review-star-{1-5}, review-name, review-comment, review-submit, cart-item-{k}, cart-prev-{k}, cart-next-{k}, checkout-name, checkout-phone, checkout-zone, checkout-address, checkout-locate, checkout-map-iframe, checkout-cod, checkout-wave, checkout-submit, catalog-card-{id}. Only cosmetic cart row layout + /auth/me 401 noise remain, both non-blocking.
